objective: Review the Micronaut Planner (web/) for UX/UI defects and for faulty claims (docs, in-app copy, scientific data), with Opus reviewers at high effort and Opus adversarial verification; produce a verified findings report and a remediation task graph. No app code changes in this run.
global_invariants: READ-ONLY: never edit anything under web/, tools/, docs/, README/ROADMAP/TASKS; never run git commit/push/checkout/stash; write only your own scratch files under the scratch dir given by the orchestrator. Read docs/cma-lessons.md first. Every finding is an object {id, severity, area, claim_or_expectation, observed, evidence, repro_steps, confidence} where evidence is a file:line, a literal command plus its output, or a screenshot path; anything you could not reproduce is labeled [Unverified] in claim_or_expectation and confidence='unverified'. severity in {blocking, major, minor, nit}; blocking = a statement shown to users that is false, or data loss / privacy.
